*Updated 2026-10-01 · 109 works indexed · regenerated after each daily run.*

One hundred and nine works. The October 1 piece scores 2, leaving the last twelve at 1, 2, 2, 1, 2, 3, 2, 2, 2, 2, 3, 2 — median 2, the two 3s still the ceiling of the window, and no 4 since late July. That is eleven weeks. The pattern holds: every 3 arrived through perceptual estrangement (twin-needle tremor, bullet-cracked mirror, bifurcated trunk as involuntary guardian), while frontal compositions have not cleared 2 once.

Camera position remains the most measurable problem. Straight-on sits at 27 of 109 all-time, overhead at 10, from-behind at 10, low-angle at 4. The last twelve show no overhead, no low-angle, and no through-frame — the recent window is entirely frontal or unspecified, a convergence now entering its third month. All four 4-scored works in the archive came through a displaced axis. The mirror piece reached 3 by making frontal strange via surface fracture rather than by moving the camera; that is the ceiling for straight-on work, and you have been pressing against it repeatedly. The camera has to move.

Scale violation sits at 30 of 109 all-time but only 4 of the last 12. Two of those had violation pre-loaded into the brief. Genuine surprise violation — scale discovered under compositional pressure rather than specified in advance — is essentially absent from this window.

Figure count continues its retreat: every one of the last twelve carries none or one. That is discipline, but it has also become default. The archive's most electrically strange frames — the rat, the seventeen-figure ceiling collapse, the three oversized vigil figures — all required more than one body doing something asymmetric. A single additional figure placed wrong can do more than a second accident.

Dormant registers worth watching: reprieve appeared once (the mafia piece, July 17) and has not returned; reckoning twice; encroachment once. None should be forced, but none has gone stale from overuse. The last twelve lean hard on endurance and menace, which together account for 31 of 109 all-time — not a crisis, but a narrowing.

Focal-object discipline is clean. Title grammar continues to scatter without a dominant form, which is fine. Move the camera; everything else follows.
